import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-98/.gov-runtime/scratch/ps/cases")
ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
CHECK = "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-98/template/governance/kernel/skills/spec-writing/check_spec.py"

form = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-98/template/governance/kernel/skills/spec-writing/spec-form.md").read_text()
example = form.split("## A short clean example")[1].split("```")[1]
CLEAN = example.strip("\n") + "\n"
ROW = "| forty sign-up requests | synthetic | QA engineer | built from a fixed seed | none | none | yes | yes |"


def drop(text, heading):
    return re.sub(r"## %s\n.*?(?=\n## |\Z)" % re.escape(heading), "", text, flags=re.S)


cases = {"clean": CLEAN}
for part in ("Problem", "Users and scenarios", "Goals", "Non-goals", "KPIs", "Test data", "Out of scope",
             "Open questions", "Accepted by"):
    cases["missing-" + part.replace(" ", "_")] = drop(CLEAN, part)
kpi = "A visitor who gives a valid email address receives a welcome message within one minute."
for name, bad in {"code-span": "A visitor calls `signup` and is welcomed.",
                  "call": "A visitor triggers send_welcome(user) and is welcomed.",
                  "path": "A visitor is welcomed by src/app/signup.py within a minute.",
                  "ext": "A visitor is welcomed as config.yaml says.",
                  "dotted": "A visitor sees account.create finish.",
                  "dotted2": "Signup.confirm runs for a visitor.",
                  "snake": "The send_welcome step finishes within a minute."}.items():
    cases["code-" + name] = CLEAN.replace(kpi, bad)
cases["no-fails"] = CLEAN.replace("  Fails if: no message arrives within five minutes, or it arrives twice.\n", "")
cases["no-owner"] = CLEAN.replace("| QA engineer |", "|  |")
cases["no-recipe"] = CLEAN.replace("built from a fixed seed", "")
cases["no-hidden"] = CLEAN.replace("| none | yes | yes |", "| none |  | yes |")
cases["imported-no-licence"] = CLEAN.replace("| synthetic | QA engineer | built from a fixed seed |", "| imported | QA engineer |  |")
cases["unsecured"] = CLEAN.replace("| yes | yes |\n", "| yes | no |\n")
cases["col-missing"] = CLEAN.replace(" owner |", "").replace(" QA engineer |", "").replace("| --- | --- | --- |", "| --- | --- |")
cases["prose-ok"] = CLEAN.replace(kpi, "A sign-up (with a valid address) gets a welcome e.g. in forty-eight seconds or 1.5 minutes. It is sent once.")
for name, text in cases.items():
    (ROOT / (name + ".md")).write_text(text)

only = sys.argv[1:]
for name in cases:
    if only and name not in only:
        continue
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, CHECK, str(ROOT / (name + ".md"))], capture_output=True, text=True)
    print("== %s -> exit %d" % (name, r.returncode))
    print(r.stdout.rstrip())
    if r.stderr:
        print("STDERR", r.stderr.rstrip())
print("P1 files:", sorted(p.name for p in ROOT.glob("*.P1.md")))
